_readme: Every exception is named individually, with a reason, and nothing here is a count.
A threshold lets a NEW failure hide behind a fixed one; a named list makes each
exception something a person decided and can be asked about later.
Delete an entry to make the check bite again.
*** WHAT IS NOT IN HERE IS THE POINT. *** The contrast and target failures this
suite reports today are REAL and are deliberately left failing. Do not silence
them here; fix them in src/, or bring a reason and add them with it.
_allowedFailedRendersWhy: Firefox times out loading the mirrored product, cart and checkout pages at every viewport - 9 of 81. The pages carry the WooCommerce blocks bundle and a Store API fetch that can never resolve offline. Not a site defect and not a Firefox defect; an artefact of mirroring. Lower this to 0 the day the mirror stubs the Store API.

contrast.why: The social-login plugin's own Facebook button. Their brand colour, their markup, their 4.23:1. Not ours to fix in src/ - raise it with the plugin or replace the button.

targets.why: 1x1 by design until focused - the standard visually-hidden skip link. WCAG 2.2 target size does not apply to a control that is not visible; when it IS focused it is full size.
Tracking and payment iframes rendered 1px tall. Not interactive targets.
An inline link inside a sentence of body text - explicitly exempt under WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (inline in a block of text).

_runtimeVarsWhy: Set per element from JS or an inline style attribute, never in a stylesheet. ambient.js writes --dur and --peak on every star it spawns; the newsletter and notice sparks carry --a/--s/--d inline. Declaring them in :root would give every element a wrong default rather than no value.
_budgetWhy: Set from what the system measures TODAY plus a little headroom, not from an aspiration:
raw 274 KB -> budget 300      gzip 47 KB -> budget 55
brotli 36 KB -> budget 45     rules 1845 -> budget 2000     !important 29 -> budget 32
The gzip number is the one that matters: it is what crosses a Bulgarian mobile network.
Raise a budget only with a reason in the commit message. A budget quietly raised to make
a build pass is not a budget.
